title: X Companion — WordPress plugin that makes a WP instance a ground-truth toolchain target for block-generating agents
mission: Expose this WordPress instance's real block registry, theme tokens, and patterns as machine-readable contracts; validate agent-generated block trees against them; provide a browser-executable serialization harness; accept agent-generated dynamic blocks into a managed library. The agent NEVER hand-writes serialized block markup and NEVER guesses what blocks exist — this plugin is why.

problem_context.why: Gutenberg persisted content is HTML with JSON-carrying comment delimiters whose validity is defined by each block's JS save() output. LLMs cannot reliably produce it. The correct architecture: agents generate a JSON Tree IR, this plugin validates it against the live registry, and a browser harness (driven by the counterpart agent plugin) compiles Tree IR -> canonical markup using the real registered save() functions.
problem_context.instance_as_ground_truth: Validity is defined by THIS site's registry (core + whatever suites are active, e.g. Kadence), not by an abstract 'WordPress'. Everything this plugin serves derives from the live registry at request time.

postures.toolchain: Plugin runs on a disposable sandbox (Playground/Studio/wp-env). All tiers enabled. Never ships to production; production receives only exported artifacts.
postures.production: Plugin installed on a live brownfield site. Introspect + author tiers only. Extend tier (block install, theme writes) is hard-disabled in code, not just hidden.

counterpart.what: A Claude Code plugin (skill + local MCP server) running on the agent's machine. It holds the credentials, runs a warm Playwright browser against this plugin's harness route to compile trees, runs the layout oracle, builds/smoke-tests blocks with Node, and POSTs finished block zips to this plugin.
counterpart.division_of_labor: This plugin serves capability (registry, validation, harness page, install target). The agent machine supplies all heavy compute (browser, Node, LLM). Nothing in this plugin requires exec(), shell, Node, or a browser on the server. Must run on lowest-common-denominator shared hosting: PHP 8.1+, WP 6.5+, writes only under wp-content/uploads.
counterpart.contract: The interfaces.rest_api section below IS the contract the counterpart codes against. Do not change shapes without bumping interfaces.version.

operating_rules_for_implementing_agent: Work until every milestone's acceptance commands pass. Do not ask questions after start.
When a detail is genuinely unspecified, choose the simplest option consistent with 'runs on shared hosting' and 'agent machine does the heavy lifting', then record it in PROGRESS.json decisions[].
Update PROGRESS.json after every milestone state change. A milestone is 'done' ONLY when its acceptance commands exit 0; paste the command + last output lines as evidence.
All code in one repo, installable as a standard WP plugin directory named x-companion/.
No frameworks. WordPress core APIs + plain PHP. No Composer runtime deps (dev-deps for tests are fine).
Every REST handler: capability check first, then input schema validation, then work. No exceptions.

If WordPress Abilities API is present (function wp_register_ability / WP >= 6.9), additionally register each REST capability as an ability with the same input/output JSON Schemas. REST routes are the primary, always-present interface; abilities are a conditional wrapper. Verify the current abilities registration signature from the WordPress/abilities-api repo before writing that wrapper.

environment.dev_target: wp-env (Docker) OR @wp-playground/cli — use whichever is available in the build environment; both must be supported by the test scripts.

test_matrix.blueprint: WP latest, Twenty Twenty-Five, no extra plugins
WP latest + Kadence Blocks (free, from wordpress.org) active

file_layout.x-companion/x-companion.php: Plugin bootstrap: constants, posture resolution, hook registration.
file_layout.x-companion/includes/class-harness.php: Harness page controller + asset enqueue logic.
Design-tokens -> theme.json writer (+ suite adapter interface).
file_layout.x-companion/includes/adapters/class-adap: Maps the same tokens into Kadence global settings. No-op if Kadence absent.
file_layout.x-companion/includes/class-rest.php: Route registration, auth, schema enforcement, posture gating.
file_layout.x-companion/harness/harness.js: window.__compile / window.__registry implementation (~80 lines, vanilla, no build step).

constants_and_options.X_COMPANION_POSTURE: Constant, 'toolchain' | 'production'. Default when undefined: 'production'. In 'production', extend-tier routes return 403 {code:'posture_forbidden'} AND are not registered as abilities.
constants_and_options.X_COMPANION_ALLOW_STATIC_BLOCKS: Constant, default false. When false, install-block rejects zips whose block.json has no "render" entry (dynamic-by-default is a hard rule: static blocks freeze save() output into content and break on iteration).
constants_and_options.x_companion_agent_hints: Filter. Signature: apply_filters('x_companion_agent_hints', array $hints, string $block_name, WP_Block_Type $type). Lets any block author declare machine-invisible constraints: allowed_blocks (string[]), template_lock (string|false), usage_notes (string), example_attributes (object). Merged into manifest per block.

capabilities.x_companion_read: introspect tier (manifest, patterns, harness, parse, render)
capabilities.x_companion_author: author tier (validate is read-tier; author covers content insert if later added — reserve the cap now)
capabilities.x_companion_extend: extend tier (install-block, library mutations, theme token writes, snapshot export)

constants_and_options.role: On activation create role 'x_agent' with read + the three caps above minus x_companion_extend; grant x_companion_extend to the role only when posture is 'toolchain'. Administrators get all three always (posture gate still applies at route level).

interfaces.auth: WordPress Application Passwords over HTTPS (Basic auth on REST). The harness route also accepts Basic auth directly since it is fetched by Playwright, not a browser session. No credential is ever stored by this plugin; no relay, no proxy — the counterpart holds the app password locally. This is a deliberate rejection of the hosted-relay/credential-custody model.

TreeIR.description: What agents generate INSTEAD of serialized markup. No innerHTML anywhere — innerHTML is a compiler output, produced only by the harness.

epoch.description: Manifest fingerprint this tree was generated against.

path.description: JSON pointer into the tree, e.g. /blocks/0/innerBlocks/2

schema_outline.fingerprint: sha256 hex of canonical JSON of: sorted block names + each block's attributes schema + parent/ancestor + api_version + active theme slug+version + active plugin slugs+versions + interfaces.version
schema_outline.blocks: map<name, {title, category, api_version, attributes (verbatim from registry), supports, parent, ancestor, provides_context, uses_context, is_dynamic (bool: has render_callback or render file), variations_count, agent_hints}>
schema_outline.patterns: [{name, title, categories, source, has_content}] — content itself via GET /patterns to keep manifest small
schema_outline.theme_tokens: resolved wp_get_global_settings() subset: color.palette (all origins), spacing.spacingSizes + spacingScale, typography.fontSizes + fontFamilies, layout.contentSize + wideSize
schema_outline.suites: [{slug, version}] for a known-suite allowlist detected among active plugins: kadence-blocks, ultimate-addons-for-gutenberg (Spectra), generateblocks, stackable-ultimate-gutenberg-blocks

rest_api.notes: Cache in a transient keyed by fingerprint inputs; invalidate on activated_plugin, deactivated_plugin, switch_theme, and after install-block. Must never serve a stale fingerprint after a registry change — recompute inputs hash cheaply on each request and rebuild the heavy body only when it moved.

validation_semantics: E_TREE_SCHEMA: body fails TreeIR schema (stop further checks).
E_EPOCH_MISMATCH: tree.epoch !== current fingerprint. Still run remaining checks (best effort) but epoch_ok=false and valid=false.

E_ATTR_TYPE / E_ATTR_ENUM: attribute value violates the registered attribute's type/enum. Coverage: type (string,number,integer,boolean,array,object,null), enum, and default-fill awareness. Do NOT attempt source-based html attribute semantics — that is the harness's job.
W_ATTR_UNKNOWN: attribute key not declared (warning: many blocks tolerate extras; supports-generated attrs like className, style, lock, metadata, align are pre-whitelisted globally).
E_NEST_PARENT / E_NEST_ANCESTOR: violates registered parent[] / ancestor[] of the child block (checked against actual chain in the tree).
W_HINT_ALLOWED_BLOCKS / W_HINT_TEMPLATE_LOCK: violates agent_hints for the containing block (warning severity because hints are best-effort declarations).
W_STATIC_NEEDS_HARNESS: block is static (is_dynamic=false); attach once per distinct static block name, fix_hint='canonical markup must come from harness compile, do not hand-serialize'.

rest_api.returns: { blocks: parse_blocks() output verbatim (name, attrs, innerBlocks, innerHTML, innerContent) }
rest_api.notes: Read-back path: lets the agent lift existing site content into trees.
Server render for preview/oracle of dynamic blocks. Run inside a faux main query guard; capture styles enqueued during render via wp_enqueue_scripts introspection where feasible, else return [].

rest_api.returns: [{name, title, categories, content (serialized markup), parsed: parse_blocks(content)}]
rest_api.notes: All registered patterns from WP_Block_Patterns_Registry, both source markup AND parsed tree, because patterns are the agent's retrieval corpus of layout idioms.

spec.purpose: The Tree IR compiler. Loaded once by the counterpart's warm Playwright instance; window.__compile is then called repeatedly.
server_side: Authenticate via Basic app-password (reuse REST auth by making this a REST route with a callback that echoes HTML and exits, so auth is uniform).

Emit a minimal HTML page (no theme, no admin chrome) that: (1) prints get_block_editor_server_block_settings() into an inline bootstrap for wp.blocks.unstable__bootstrapServerSideBlockDefinitions — exactly as core's editor does; (2) enqueues wp-blocks, wp-block-library, wp-element, wp-data, wp-dom-ready, wp-i18n; (3) for every WP_Block_Type in the registry, enqueues all handles in editor_script_handles (this is how third-party blocks self-register client-side); (4) fires do_action('enqueue_block_editor_assets') wrapped in try/catch-equivalent (shutdown handler) because some plugins assume full admin — if a fatal occurs, serve the page WITHOUT that action and set header X-Harness-Degraded: enqueue_block_editor_assets; (5) enqueues harness/harness.js last.

harness_js_api.window.__ready: Promise resolving after DOMContentLoaded + one tick, when registration has settled.
harness_js_api.window.__registry(): returns string[] of wp.blocks.getBlockTypes() names. The counterpart diffs this against manifest.blocks to detect blocks whose editor script failed to load client-side.
harness_js_api.window.__compile(tree): tree = TreeIR.blocks (array of BlockNode). Recursively wp.blocks.createBlock(name, attributes, innerBlocks) — createBlock applies defaults and sanitizes attrs; then wp.blocks.serialize(blocks) -> markup; then wp.blocks.parse(markup) and walk it collecting isValid per block with its clientId path. Returns { markup: string, all_valid: bool, invalid: [{path, name, validation_issues: any}] }. Wrap the whole body in try/catch and return { error: message } on throw — never leave the caller hanging.

spec.known_risk_and_fallback: Some third-party blocks may fail to register outside the real editor DOM/stores. Detection: __registry() diff. Documented fallback (implement only the detection, document the fallback for the counterpart): counterpart loads wp-admin/post-new.php via Playwright and injects harness.js into the editor iframe. Record in README.

rest_api.returns: { installed: {slug, name, version}, fingerprint: string, replaced_previous: bool }
spec: Zip must contain exactly one top-level dir OR flat files, with block.json at root of the block.

block.json requirements enforced: name matches ^agent/[a-z0-9-]+$ (namespace filterable via 'x_companion_block_namespace'); "render" entry present pointing to an existing render.php in the zip, UNLESS X_COMPANION_ALLOW_STATIC_BLOCKS. Reject otherwise with 422 {code:'block_policy', reasons:[...]}.

Structural validation only — NO php -l, NO exec. The safety gate is on the counterpart (Playground smoke-test before POSTing). Server responsibilities: sanitize slug, reject path traversal in zip entries, size cap 5MB, verify block.json parses, verify every file referenced by block.json exists in the zip.
Install target: wp_upload_dir()/x-agent-blocks/{slug}/ . If slug exists, move current to {slug}.prev/ (single-level rollback) before extracting.

Registrar (runs on init, always, both postures — installed blocks must keep rendering even in production posture): glob upload_dir/x-agent-blocks/*/block.json, register_block_type(dir) each, individually wrapped so one broken block cannot fatal the site: pre-check with a file_exists + json_decode guard; render.php fatals are contained per-request by WordPress's block rendering, and rollback exists.
After successful install: bust manifest transient, recompute fingerprint, return it. The returned fingerprint is the new epoch the counterpart must adopt.

rest_api.notes: Refuse (409 {code:'in_use', posts:[ids]}) if any published content contains the block name (WP_Query s= '<!-- wp:'+name limited scan, best effort).

rest_api.body: DesignTokens (schema shipped in fixtures/design-tokens.schema.json; outline: {palette:[{slug,name,color,role}], spacing:{scale_unit, steps:[{slug,size}]}, typography:{families:[{slug,name,fontFamily}], sizes:[{slug,size,fluid?}]}, layout:{contentSize, wideSize}})
spec: Compile tokens into the ACTIVE theme's theme.json settings (merge, preserving unrelated keys) — settings.color.palette, settings.spacing.spacingSizes, settings.typography.fontSizes/fontFamilies, settings.layout. Write via filesystem only if the theme dir is writable; otherwise write to wp_get_global_settings user origin via the global styles CPT (wp_global_styles) — implement the CPT path as primary since it works everywhere and survives theme updates.

Then iterate registered suite adapters (interface: supports(): bool; apply(tokens): string[] of change notes). Ship the Kadence adapter: map palette into Kadence's global palette option and spacing into its defaults where its option schema allows; adapter must introspect option shape defensively and no-op with a logged note on mismatch rather than guess.

rest_api.spec: Minimal viable artifact bundle for promotion/cloning: /theme/ (active theme dir if child or block theme), /agent-blocks/ (the library), /patterns.json (GET /patterns payload), /content.xml (WXR export of published posts+pages), /manifest.json (current manifest incl. fingerprint). This is the 'production receives artifacts, not the toolchain' pipeline's wire format.

rest_api.notes: Cheap epoch check the counterpart calls before every batch; also the promotion gate primitive (compare sandbox vs prod fingerprints).

acceptance: tests/harness.spec.ts (Playwright, lives in this repo's tests/, node dev-dep OK): loads /harness with Basic auth on core-only env; __registry() superset-of manifest.blocks keys for core; __compile(fixtures/trees/valid-core.json) returns all_valid=true and markup containing '<!-- wp:'; injected bad tree returns invalid[] non-empty

Same spec against core-plus-suite: either passes for a Kadence rowlayout fixture tree OR the degraded-registration case is detected via __registry diff and reported (assert one of the two, log which — this feeds the documented fallback)

snapshot zip contains all five entries and manifest.json fingerprint matches GET /fingerprint

schema.decisions: [{when, what, why}] — every unspecified-detail choice goes here
schema.deviations: [{when, spec_ref, what, why}] — any place implementation had to diverge from this spec; empty is the goal

rules: Initialize with all milestones pending before writing any code.
Never mark done without pasted passing acceptance output in evidence.
If blocked > 3 attempts on the same failure, mark blocked with the failure detail and move to the next non-dependent milestone; return after.

non_goals: No content-authoring routes (post insert/update) in v1 — the counterpart uses core REST for that.
No LSP (separate client over /manifest + /validate, out of scope).
No hosted relay, no credential storage, no OAuth server — Application Passwords only, held by the counterpart.
No attempt to execute or lint PHP from installed packages server-side.
No suite adapters beyond Kadence in v1 (interface must make adding Spectra/GenerateBlocks a one-file affair).
